newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut bourse trade commissions to change.
newsitem.headline: Beirut bourse trade commissions to change.

text.p: A decree approved by the cabinet will reduce commissions charged on transactions by the Beirut Stock Exchange and change the way they are calculated, a stock exchange official said on Thursday.
The decree, approved at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday, introduces commissioning by bracket instead of the present flat rate.

"Instead of a flat rate of five per thousand, the new decree sets a four per thousand rate for transactions up to $100,000 and 2.5 per thousand for transactions ranging between $100,000 and $1 million and finally one per thousand for all deals over $1 million," a bourse official said.
The change was intended to encourage more trade and make the market more liquid, he said. It will take effect when the decree is published in the state gazette, which is expected shortly.
